title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Lead by Going Last
caption:
The room follows the man who took the worst seat first.

He takes the task nobody wants. Apologizes first, even when he's only half wrong. Absorbs the blame that isn't fully his. Stays when staying costs him something.

Whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant (Matthew 20:26). Leadership was never about the title. It's about who goes first into the cost, and last out of the room.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #servanthood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
